review_reference: Owner, 2026-11-14, during the outreach: "we should collect genotype and blood group" (both optional; a screening still saves without them). NOT SIGNED: to be signed by the owner. Declares 0122 alone, on the assumption that production has applied 0120 and 0121 (the signed 0120+0121 declaration released on 2026-11-13); if production's pending set still holds them, the release refuses (UNREVIEWED_PENDING_MIGRATIONS) and this declaration must list them with 0122.
evidence: Migration 0122_outreach_screening_blood.sql (placeholder; releases right after 0121). runtime-grants.sql is unchanged. WHAT IT DOES: outreach.registration_screenings (0118) gains two nullable text columns with no default: genotype (CHECK registration_screenings_genotype_check: 'AA','AS','AC','SS','SC','CC','unknown') and blood_group (CHECK registration_screenings_blood_group_check: 'A+','A-','B+','B-','AB+','AB-','O+','O-','unknown'), the same codes as outreach-api and the website. The CHECKs are added NOT VALID, then validated. Nothing else changes: 0118's trigger never names the clinical columns, so its version, facility, actor, suspension and redaction rules cover the new columns; row-level security, policies and the table grant (select, insert, update to hid_outreach_runtime) are per table; a redaction deletes the whole screening row; audit rows stay ids only. PRECONDITIONS (55000, nothing applied): 0118 applied, neither column present. POST-CHECKS: both columns nullable text with no default, both CHECKs validated, no hid_* runtime role may DELETE a screening. LOCKS: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on outreach.registration_screenings, NOWAIT every 10 ms for at most 5 seconds (then 55P03, nothing applied), held to commit; no row is rewritten; the validation reads the screening rows once (every new value is null). OLD SERVICES: today's outreach-api reads with select * and ignores the new columns, its insert leaves them null, and its update names its own columns, so it keeps a recorded genotype and blood group. Proven on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 with fictional data: 0122 applied to a 0121 database already holding a screening; today's outreach-api build read, updated and listed before and after 0122; the new build set genotype AS and blood group O-, today's build then updated the same screening and both values were kept; the new build kept them when left out, cleared genotype with null, answered a database refusal of genotype XX as 422, and replayed a same-key save. All 94 database suites pass on 0001-0122, including outreach-screening.integration.sql with 40 new 0122 cases (78 in all): every code accepted, wrong codes refused by constraint name (XX, aa, 'AA ', 'A+ ', o+, the Unicode minus, Not known), null allowed, versioned updates, visibility unchanged, deleted with a redacted registration. ROLLBACK: a later migration dropping the two columns; today's outreach-api never reads or writes them.
